rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_9q_anc(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	b int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	a int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	b1B0260 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  b1B0261 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  b1B0262 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  b1B0263 int(7) DEFAULT 0,

	a1B0260 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  a1B0261 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  a1B0262 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  a1B0263 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_9q_anc WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_9q_anc (
SELECT @id,h.hoscode
,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
	,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543

,COUNT(DISTINCT t.cid) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF((t.before_2q=1 AND t.before_code in('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263')) OR (t.after_2q=1 AND t.after_code in('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263'))   ,t.cid,NULL)) result

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.before_2q=1 AND t.before_code in('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263')   ,t.cid,NULL)) b
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.after_2q=1 AND t.after_code in('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263')  ,t.cid,NULL)) a

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.before_2q=1 AND t.before_code in('1B0260') ,t.cid,NULL)) b1B0260
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.before_2q=1 AND t.before_code in('1B0261') ,t.cid,NULL)) b1B0261
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.before_2q=1 AND t.before_code in('1B0262') ,t.cid,NULL)) b1B0262
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.before_2q=1 AND t.before_code in('1B0263') ,t.cid,NULL)) b1B0263

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.after_2q=1 AND t.after_code in('1B0260')  ,t.cid,NULL)) a1B0260 
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.after_2q=1 AND t.after_code in('1B0261')  ,t.cid,NULL)) a1B0261
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.after_2q=1 AND t.after_code in('1B0262')  ,t.cid,NULL)) a1B0262
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.after_2q=1 AND t.after_code in('1B0263')  ,t.cid,NULL)) a1B0263

FROM  t_person_cid p 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN tmp_9q_anc t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND (t.before_2q=1 OR t.after_2q=1)
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9)

GROUP BY h.hoscode
);
rows.aname: จำนวนประชากรในเขตรับผิดชอบกลุ่มหญิงตั้งครรภ์ที่สิ้นสุดการตั้งครรภ์ในปีงบประมาณที่ 2Q  ผิดปกติ ได้รับการประเมินโรคซึมเศร้า (9Q)
rows.bname: จำนวนประชากรในเขตรับผิดชอบกลุ่มหญิงตั้งครรภ์ที่สิ้นสุดการตั้งครรภ์ในปีงบประมาณ ที่ 2Q ผิดปกติ
rows.notice:
รหัสการการประเมินโรคซึมเศร้า (9Q) ในกลุ่มหญิงตั้งครรภ์ คือ 1B0260=>ปกติ,1B0261=>ซึมเศร้าน้อย ,1B0262=>ซึมเศร้าปานกลาง ,1B0263=>ซึมเศร้ารุนแรง
การประมวลผลรายงาน
- หญิงตั้งครรภ์ที่สิ้นสุดการตั้งครรภ์ด้วยการคลอด/แท้งบุตร ในปีงบประมาณ
- ได้รับการคัดกรองขณะตั้งครรภ์ ค้นหาประวัติย้อนหลังตั้งแต่ BDATE - 40 WEEKS ถึง BDATE
- ได้รับการคัดกรองหลังการตั้งครรภ์ ค้นหาประวัติตั้งแต่ BDATE ถึง BDATE + 42 days
- สำหรับรายงานนี้ประมวลผลตามผังการปฏิบัติงาน คือ จะประเมิน 9Q จะต้องมีผล 2Q ผิดปกติจึงจะทำการประเมิน 9Q

rows.indiv_sql:
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx(
SELECT p.hospcode, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA,p.DISCHARGE
,t.gravida,t.bdate,t.bplace,t.bhosp
,t.before_date,t.before_code,t.before_hosp,t.before_input_hosp
,t.after_date,t.after_code,t.after_hosp,t.after_input_hosp
,IF(t.before_2q=1,'ผิดปกติ','ปกติ') AS before_2q
,IF(t.after_2q=1,'ผิดปกติ','ปกติ') AS after_2q
,IF(t.before_2q=1 AND t.before_code IN('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263'),'นับผลงาน','' ) before_result
,IF(t.after_2q=1 AND t.after_code IN('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263'),'นับผลงาน','' ) after_result
FROM  t_person_cid p 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN tmp_9q_anc t  ON p.cid=t.cid 
			AND (t.before_code IN('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263') 
								OR t.after_code IN('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263')
								OR t.before_2q=1 OR t.after_2q=1
							)
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9)
GROUP BY t.cid
);
SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA,d.DISCHARGE
,d.gravida,d.bdate,d.bplace,d.bhosp
,d.before_date,d.before_code,d.before_hosp,d.before_input_hosp
,d.after_date,d.after_code,d.after_hosp,d.after_input_hosp,d.before_2q,d.after_2q,d.before_result,d.after_result
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("b") as "b" ,SUM("a") as "a" ,SUM("b1b0260") as "b1b0260" ,SUM("b1b0261") as "b1b0261" ,SUM("b1b0262") as "b1b0262" ,SUM("b1b0263") as "b1b0263" ,SUM("a1b0260") as "a1b0260" ,SUM("a1b0261") as "a1b0261" ,SUM("a1b0262") as "a1b0262" ,SUM("a1b0263") as "a1b0263"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

province.query: SELECT h.chw_code as a_code,h.chw_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("b") as "b" ,SUM("a") as "a" ,SUM("b1b0260") as "b1b0260" ,SUM("b1b0261") as "b1b0261" ,SUM("b1b0262") as "b1b0262" ,SUM("b1b0263") as "b1b0263" ,SUM("a1b0260") as "a1b0260" ,SUM("a1b0261") as "a1b0261" ,SUM("a1b0262") as "a1b0262" ,SUM("a1b0263") as "a1b0263"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.chw_code, h.chw_name ORDER BY h.chw_code

moo.query: SELECT s.areacode as a_code ,CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 7 THEN SUBSTRING(s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 1) WHEN LENGTH(s.areacode) = 8 THEN SUBSTRING(s.areacode FROM 7 FOR 2) ELSE 'ไม่ระบุ' END AS a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("b") as "b" ,SUM("a") as "a" ,SUM("b1b0260") as "b1b0260" ,SUM("b1b0261") as "b1b0261" ,SUM("b1b0262") as "b1b0262" ,SUM("b1b0263") as "b1b0263" ,SUM("a1b0260") as "a1b0260" ,SUM("a1b0261") as "a1b0261" ,SUM("a1b0262") as "a1b0262" ,SUM("a1b0263") as "a1b0263"  FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY s.areacode ORDER BY s.areacode

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name , SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("b") as "b" ,SUM("a") as "a" ,SUM("b1b0260") as "b1b0260" ,SUM("b1b0261") as "b1b0261" ,SUM("b1b0262") as "b1b0262" ,SUM("b1b0263") as "b1b0263" ,SUM("a1b0260") as "a1b0260" ,SUM("a1b0261") as "a1b0261" ,SUM("a1b0262") as "a1b0262" ,SUM("a1b0263") as "a1b0263"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE h.hostype IN('05','06','07','11','12','15') AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.hoscode, h.hosname ORDER BY h.hoscode

service_plan.query: SELECT h.splevel as a_code ,h.splevel as a_name ,   		 SUM(target) as target  		 ,SUM(result) as result  		,SUM(b) as b 		,SUM(a) as a 		,SUM(b1B0260) as b1B0260 		,SUM(b1B0261) as b1B0261 		,SUM(b1B0262) as b1B0262 		,SUM(b1B0263) as b1B0263 		 		,SUM(a1B0260) as a1B0260 		,SUM(a1B0261) as a1B0261 		,SUM(a1B0262) as a1B0262 		,SUM(a1B0263) as a1B0263  FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
